Bulbasaur

Grass Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Bulbasaur is a Grass/Poison-type Seed Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 6.9 kg. It evolves into Ivysaur. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (65), with a base stat total of 318.
